bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 51;; esac
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
stage="$root/.worktrees/video-gallery-flow-034fa01"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "034fa012cf96e0288591fbe4bc16b90cee1acfa0" || exit 52
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 53
ids="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 || exit 54
cur="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$ids")"
tag="create-videobot:before-gallery-034fa01"
if docker image inspect "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$tag")" = "$cur" || exit 55
else
  docker image tag "$cur" "$tag"
fi
docker build --pull=false --network none -t create-videobot:gallery-flow-034fa01 -f - "$stage" <<'DOCKERFILE'
FROM create-videobot:before-gallery-034fa01
USER root
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/creatorBot.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorBot.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/creatorScreenTransport.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorScreenTransport.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/mediaProcessor.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/mediaProcessor.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/privateMediaUpload.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/privateMediaUpload.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/runtime/creatorMigrateDockerSmoke.mjs /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorMigrateDockerSmoke.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/sales/pgListings.mjs /opt/videobot/src/sales/pgListings.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node sql/017_video_description.sql /opt/videobot/sql/017_video_description.sql
USER node
DOCKERFILE
docker run --rm --pull never --network none --read-only --entrypoint node -v "$stage/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" create-videobot:gallery-flow-034fa01 --test test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/privateMediaUpload.test.mjs test/pgListings.test.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/creatorMigrate.test.mjs
echo VIDEO_ALBUM_EDITOR_DOCKER_TEST=PASS
echo VIDEO_ALBUM_EDITOR_IMAGE_READY=PASS
